# The Hartford

> > The Hartford provides business and personal insurance solutions, including specialized coverage for small businesses and AARP member programs for auto and homeowners insurance.

The Hartford offers Business Owner's Policies (BOP) tailored to diverse industries from construction to cosmetology, alongside AARP-branded insurance programs featuring the TrueLane Program and senior discounts. The site also provides business strategy resources covering brand equity, hiring, and marketing archetypes.

## Key Topics

- Business Owner's Policy (BOP)
- AARP Auto Insurance Program
- AARP Homeowners Insurance Program
- TrueLane Program
- General Liability
- Professional Liability
- Small Business Insurance
- Commercial Property Coverage
- Workers Compensation
- Insurance Discounts
- AARP Member Benefits
- Brand Archetypes
- Senior Auto Insurance
- Retail Insurance
- Construction Insurance

## AARP Insurance Programs

- [AARP Car Insurance From The Hartford](https://www.thehartford.com/aarp/car-insurance): AARP auto insurance with TrueLane Program and senior discounts
- [Bundle the Best Auto and Home Insurance for Seniors](https://www.thehartford.com/aarp/car-insurance/seniors/homeowners-and-auto): AARP auto and home insurance bundle discounts for seniors
- [Is Auto Insurance Cheaper After 65?](https://www.thehartford.com/aarp/car-insurance/seniors/cheaper-as-you-get-older): AARP auto insurance rates and discounts for seniors 65+
- [UMBI Insurance](https://www.thehartford.com/aarp/car-insurance/uninsured-underinsured-motorist-coverage): Uninsured/underinsured motorist bodily injury coverage explained
- [AARP Homeowners Insurance in Utah](https://www.thehartford.com/aarp/homeowners-insurance/utah): Utah homeowners insurance with AARP member benefits and discounts
- [Homeowners Insurance in Colorado](https://www.thehartford.com/aarp/homeowners-insurance/colorado): Colorado homeowners insurance with AARP program benefits

## Small Business Insurance by Industry

- [Construction Insurance](https://www.thehartford.com/business-insurance/construction): Specialized construction insurance including pollution & liability coverage
- [Cosmetology Insurance for Your Small Business](https://www.thehartford.com/business-insurance/cosmetology-insurance): BOP coverage for cosmetologists and beauty businesses
- [Nail Salon Insurance | Nail Technician Insurance](https://www.thehartford.com/business-insurance/nail-salon-insurance): Nail salon and technician insurance with professional liability coverage
- [Pet Grooming Insurance | Get Dog Grooming Insurance](https://www.thehartford.com/business-insurance/pet-groomer): Pet grooming and dog daycare business insurance coverage
- [Butcher Shop Insurance | Get a Free Quote Today](https://www.thehartford.com/business-insurance/butcher-shop-insurance): Business Owner's Policy for butcher shops covering liability & equipment
- [Managed Service Provider (MSPs) Insurance Plans](https://www.thehartford.com/business-insurance/msp-insurance): BOP insurance for managed service providers and IT professionals
- [Antique Dealers Insurance](https://www.thehartford.com/business-insurance/antiques-dealer-insurance): BOP for antique dealers covering liability, property damage, and theft

## Professional Services Insurance

- [Life Coach Insurance Solutions That Help Protect Your Practice](https://www.thehartford.com/business-insurance/life-coach-insurance): Professional liability and BOP coverage for life coaches
- [Audiologist Insurance | Protect Your Practice](https://www.thehartford.com/business-insurance/audiologist-insurance): Professional liability and malpractice coverage for audiologists
